top1.title: 【2026-11-12】DeepMind、細胞ごとの遺伝子変異の影響を予測するAlphaGenome 2を公開
top1.lead1: Google DeepMindが、遺伝子変異の影響を細胞の種類や状態ごとに予測するAlphaGenome 2を公開した。
top1.lead2: 疾患の仕組みや治療標的の研究への活用が期待される。一方、詳細な予測には従来モデルより高い計算コストがかかる。

top10.title: 【2026-11-12】DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 to predict the effects of genetic mutations in individual cells
top10.summary: Trained on more than 100 million cell profiles across 68 tissues. While it is expected to support disease research, its computational costs are higher than those of previous models.

top10.title: 【2026-11-12】OpenAI quarterly revenue reportedly exceeds $10 billion for the first time
top10.summary: According to Bloomberg, quarterly revenue surpassed $10 billion for the first time, driven by demand for its models. Its adjusted operating margin remains negative.

top10.title: 【2026-11-12】UK AI chip company Fractile raises $720 million in Series C funding
top10.summary: The UK's Sovereign AI Fund also invested. Fractile aims to accelerate inference with proprietary chips and a compiler, and plans to ship its first chip and system the following year.

top10.title: 【2026-11-12】CoreWeave looks to customer prepayments and short-term contracts to fund AI infrastructure expansion
top10.summary: The company is prioritizing customer prepayments and loans secured by contracts. While seeking higher prices on short-term contracts, it faces risks involving sustained demand, contract renewals and price fluctuations.

top10.title: 【2026-11-12】Databricks announces updated Genie that autonomously executes multistep tasks
top10.summary: A mechanism that supplies context from internal company data enables it to handle lengthy, multistep tasks. The CEO demonstrated real-world use in employee surveys and sales opportunity analysis.

top10.title: 【2026-11-12】US House member reportedly prepares subpoena seeking explanation of allegations from NVIDIA CEO Huang
top10.summary: A US House member requested a private briefing concerning ties to a person suspected of being a Chinese spy. The lawmaker was reportedly prepared to issue a subpoena if Huang did not comply.

top10.title: 【2026-11-12】Google releases Tabletop, an experimental tool for creating collaborative apps using natural language
top10.summary: The tool uses AI to generate collaborative tools such as travel planners and chore charts. The beta is available through a waitlist to people aged 18 and older in the United States.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
